sources.numbered_content: L00001: # [EMNLP 2024]DA-Code: Agent Data Science Code Generation Benchmark for Large Language Models L00002: L00003: ## Overview L00004: L00005: L00006: L00007: ## ⚙️ Quickstart L00008: L00009: ### Install Docker L00010: L00011: Our agent and experiments need to run in a sandbox environment using Docker, so please follow the instructions in the [Docker setup guide](https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/) to install Docker on your machine. L00012: L00013: ### Install required packages L00014: L00015: ```bash L00016: pip install -r requirements.txt L00017: ``` L00018: L00019: ### Set LLM API Key L00020: L00021: ```bash L00022: export AZURE_API_KEY=your_azure_api_key L00023: export AZURE_ENDPOINT=your_azure_endpoint L00024: export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key L00025: export GEMINI_API_KEY=your_genmini_api_key L00026: ``` L00027: L00028: ### Run the benchmark L00029: L00030: ```bash L00031: python run.py L00032: ``` L00033: L00034: Arguments: L00035: L00036: - `--max_steps`: Maximum number of steps (default is 20) L00037: - `--max_memory_length`: Maximum length of memory to retain (default is 15) L00038: - `--suffix`: Suffix for the filename (default is an empty string) L00039: - `--model`: Model to use for the benchmark (default is "gpt-4") L00040: - `--temperature`: Sampling temperature (default is 0.0) L00041: - `--top_p`: Top p sampling parameter (default is 0.9) L00042: - `--max_tokens`: Maximum number of tokens per generation (default is 1500) L00043: - `--stop_token`: Token that triggers stop in generation (default is None) L00044: - `--task_config`: Path to the meta configuration file (default is "da_code/configs/examples.jsonl") L00045: - `--source_dir`: Directory for source files (default is "da_code/source") L00046: - `--example_index`: Index range of the examples to run (default is "all") L00047: - `--example_name`: Name of the example to run (default is an empty string) L00048: - `--overwriting`: Enables overwriting existing files (default is False) L00049: - `--retry_failed`: Retry failed evaluations (default is False) L00050: - `--output_dir`: Directory for output files (default is "output") L00051: L00052: ### Evaluate the benchmark L00053: L00054: ```bash L00055: python evaluate.py \ L00056: --output_dir output/gpt4turbo \ L00057: --gold_dir da_code/gold \ L00058: --eval_json da_code/configs/eval/all.jsonl \ L00059: --result_file results/gpt4.json \ L00060: --timeout_seconds 300 L00061: ``` L00062: L00063: Arguments: L00064: L00065: - `--output_dir`: Directory for output files L00066: - `--gold_dir`: Directory for gold files L00067: - `--eval_json`: Path to the evaluation configuration file L00068: - `--result_dir`: Directory to save the evaluation results L00069: - `--timeout_seconds`: Timeout in seconds for each evaluation L00070: L00071: ### Get Full Dataset L00072: L00073: We provide 100 examples of the dataset in the source folder. To get the full dataset, follow the instructions below: L00074: L00075: * Download the **source data** from [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eM_FVT1tlY4XXp6b7TrKzgTWOvskrjTs/view?usp=sharing) L00076: L00077: > You can also use `gdown` liberay to download the gold data: L00078: > First, `pip install gdown` L00079: > Then, run command `gdown "https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1ZGi0iNv797OneK_b2l2thJCulP6NUf7v" -O source.zip` L00080: > L00081: * Unzip the dataset to da_code/source L00082: L00083: ```bash L00084: unzip source.zip -d da_code/source L00085: ``` L00086: L00087: * Download the **gold data** from [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WxcrijbCgdHzFSSSt2HVlkJqQrBWQ2IL/view?usp=sharing) L00088: L00089: > You can also use `gdown` liberay to download the gold data: L00090: > First, `pip install gdown` L00091: > Then, run command `gdown "https://drive.google.com/uc?` L00092: > L00093: * Unzip the gold data to da_code/gold L00094: L00095: ```bash L00096: unzip gold.zip -d da_code/gold L00097: ``` L00098: L00099: ## BibTex L00100: L00101: ``` L00102: @misc{huang2024dacodeagentdatascience, L00103: title={DA-Code: Agent Data Science Code Generation Benchmark for Large Language Models}, L00104: author={Yiming Huang and Jianwen Luo and Yan Yu and Yitong Zhang and Fangyu Lei and Yifan Wei and Shizhu He and Lifu Huang and Xiao Liu and Jun Zhao and Kang Liu}, L00105: year={2024}, L00106: eprint={2410.07331}, L00107: archivePrefix={arXiv}, L00108: primaryClass={cs.CL}, L00109: url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07331}, L00110: } L00111: ```

L00141:     def _get_trajectory_info_from_json(self,result_file):

L00143:             result = json.load(f)
L00144:         trajectory = result["trajectory"]
L00145:         actions = []
L00146:         for i, step in enumerate(trajectory):
L00147:             if i+1 < len(trajectory):
L00148:                 observation = trajectory[i+1]["observation"]
L00149:                 if "executed successfully. No output." in observation:
L00150:                     observation = "execution succeeded"
L00151:                 elif observation.startswith("Failed to parse action from your response,"):
L00152:                     observation = "action parse failed"
L00153:                 elif observation.startswith("ERROR:") or "Traceback (" in observation or \
L00154:                     observation.startswith("bash: -c: line ") or "Error: " in observation:
L00155:                     observation = "error message"
L00156:                 elif "Warning:" in observation:
L00157:                     observation = "warning message"
L00158:                 else:
L00159:                     # if "error" in observation.lower():
L00160:                     #     print(f"Unknown observation: {observation}\n{result_file}")
L00161:                     observation = "standard output"
L00162:             else:
L00163:                 observation = ""
L00164: 
L00165:             if step["action"].startswith("Bash"):
L00166:                 actions.append(("Bash", step["code"], observation))
L00167:             elif step["action"].startswith("Python"):
L00168:                 actions.append(("Python", len(step["code"].split("\n")), observation))
L00169:             elif step["action"].startswith("SQL"):
L00170:                 actions.append(("SQL", step["code"], observation))

L00172:                 actions.append(("Terminate", "", observation))
L00173:             else:

L00175: 
L00176:         info = {"finished": result["finished"], "steps": result["steps"], 
L00177:                 "result": result["result"],
L00178:                 "added_files": result["result_files"]["added_files"],
L00179:                 "changed_files": result["result_files"]["changed_files"],
L00180:                 "actions": actions}
L00181:         return info

L00192:             # print(f"result_file: {result_file}")

L00195:             result_file = [result_file]

L00019: def check_yaml_file(result: str, rules: Dict[str, List[Tuple[str, List[Union[str, int, List[Any]]], Any]]], **kwargs) -> float:
L00020:     """
L00021:     @args:
L00022:         result(str): path to yaml file in localhost
L00023:         rules(List[Tuple[str, List[str], Any]]): a list of rules, each rule is a tuple of (match_type, key_path, expected_value)
L00024:     @return:
L00025:         float: 1.0 if all rules are matched, 0.0 otherwise
L00026:     """
L00027:     
L00028:     try:
L00029:         if result is None: return 0
L00030:         with open(result, 'r') as inf:
L00031:             config = yaml.safe_load(inf)
L00032:         for rule in rules:
L00033:             match_type, key_path, expected_value = rule
L00034:             value = config
L00035:             for key in key_path:
L00036:                 if type(value) == dict:
L00037:                     value = value[key]
L00038:                 else: # type(value) == list
L00039:                     if is_int(key):
L00040:                         value = value[int(key)]
L00041:                     else:
L00042:                         k, v = key # use key=value pair to determine which element to choose
L00043:                         for k_v in value:
L00044:                             if k_v[k] == v:
L00045:                                 value = k_v
L00046:                                 break
L00047:                         else:
L00048:                             raise ValueError(f'[ERROR]: {key}={value} not found in yaml list!')
L00049:             if match_type == 'match':
L00050:                 if value != expected_value:
L00051:                     return 0
L00052:             elif match_type == 'in':
L00053:                 if value not in expected_value:
L00054:                     return 0
L00055:             elif match_type == 'contain':
L00056:                 if expected_value not in value:
L00057:                     return 0
L00058:             elif match_type == 'not_null':
L00059:                 if not value:
L00060:                     return 0
L00061:             else: raise ValueError('[ERROR]: unknown match type!')
L00062:         return 1
L00063:     except Exception as e:
L00064:         logger.info('Unexpected error occurred when checking yaml file', e)
L00065:         return 0
